_note: Palm reading content, verbatim from the Horoscope Launcher APK (ww5, s23.n, s77, c56, tq6). Used by palm-engine.js and palm-result.js.

handMeaning.dominant: Your dominant hand: who you're becoming and the choices you're making now.
handMeaning.nonDominant: Your non-dominant hand: your inner nature and the gifts you were born with.

element.EARTH: Someone the world can lean on.
element.FIRE: Born to set things in motion.
element.WATER: You feel the world more deeply than most.

mount.JUPITER: Your drive to lead sets you apart.
mount.SATURN: Your patience and depth set you apart.
mount.APOLLO: Your creative spark sets you apart.
mount.MERCURY: Your way with words sets you apart.

bodies: A square palm with shorter fingers: an Earth hand. Dependable, patient, quietly strong.
Square palm, sturdy fingers. You're a builder: slow, sure and hard to knock off course.
An Earth hand. You trust what's real and turn ideas into things that last.
A square palm with long fingers: an Air hand. Quick mind, quick tongue, endless curiosity.
Air hands belong to thinkers and talkers. You connect ideas, and people.
An Air hand. You spot patterns others miss and explain them well.
A long palm with shorter fingers: a Fire hand. Energy, nerve and warmth.
Fire hands belong to starters. You act while others hesitate.
A Fire hand. When you care about something, everyone knows it.
A long palm with long fingers: a Water hand. You feel deeply and read people well.
Water hands belong to dreamers and healers. People come to you to feel understood.
A Water hand. Rich imagination, real empathy.

endPhrase.BETWEEN: ends between your index and middle fingers.
endPhrase.SHORT: stops short of your middle finger.

bodies: The idealist's heart. You hold out for the real thing, then give it everything.
You see the best in the people you love, and expect it too.
Love is a promise to you. Loyal, devoted, hard to fool.
High standards, deep devotion. When you commit, you commit fully.
The balanced heart: openly warm, careful about who gets close.
Warmth backed by good judgement. Trust, once earned, runs deep.
You give generously, not blindly. Your relationships tend to last.
Heart and head work together. You love fully without losing yourself.
A passionate, direct heart. You know what you feel and say it.
You love boldly and act on it. Mixed signals aren't your style.
Heart first, explanations later. People always know where they stand.
Strong feelings, honestly shown.
You show love through actions, not speeches. Fiercely protective of your people.
A small circle, deeply valued. You prove you care by turning up.
Practical in love: you fix, help and stay.
You keep your heart for the few who matter, and never let them down.

startPhrase.JOINED: begins joined to your life line
startPhrase.CLOSE: starts just apart from your life line
startPhrase.APART: starts clearly apart from your life line

reachPhrase.true: across to beneath your little finger

JOINED: You weigh things up before acting.
You plan with the people around you in mind.
CLOSE: You trust your own judgement early.
You hear the advice, then decide for yourself.
APART: That gap marks an independent mind.
Striking out on your own suits you.
Self-directed: you'd rather try than wait.

STRAIGHT: The straight run means a clear, practical head.
Logic leads. You cut straight to the real problem.
GENTLE: The gentle dip balances logic with imagination.
Practical, with a creative streak when it counts.
You plan the detail and still see the big picture.
SLOPING: The slope adds imagination: your ideas are your own.
A creative mind that thinks in pictures.
You solve problems sideways, and it works.

arcPhrase.true: Your life line sweeps in a wide arc around your thumb
arcPhrase.false: Your life line stays close to your thumb

fullPhrase.true: and runs all the way to your wrist.

closer.true: Its full sweep adds staying power.
closer.false: A shorter life line isn't a shorter life: in palmistry it speaks to how you spend your energy.

bodies: A wide arc points to energy and a real appetite for life. New places and people recharge you.
Plenty of drive. You say yes to new experiences.
You live fully and bounce back from setbacks fast.
Restless in the best way: adventure keeps you going.
A close arc points to steady, grounded energy. Home and routine recharge you.
You pace yourself and go the distance.
Calm and rooted: your strength comes from the people closest to you.
Steady energy, used wisely. You know when to rest and when to push.

besideLife.opening: Your fate line rises from beside your life line near the wrist.
bodies: A self-made path, with people close to you cheering you on.
Your direction comes from your own effort, and it's all the stronger for it.
You're building something of your own, step by step.
Purpose found early, and earned.

middle.opening: Your fate line rises up the middle of your palm.
bodies: A clear sense of purpose. Your work tends to get noticed.
You know where you're headed, and you tend to get there.
A steady calling, followed with conviction.

none.opening: No clear fate line shows on this palm.
bodies: In palmistry, that means you write your own story.
No fixed path: you're free to reinvent yourself.
Your best chances often come from unexpected directions.
A strong index finger lifts the Mount of Jupiter. A natural leader with healthy ambition.
Jupiter stands out in your hand: confidence, generosity, high aims.
A long middle finger raises the Mount of Saturn. Wise, responsible, patient.
Saturn gives you depth. You value truth over flattery, and your advice is good.
Your ring finger lifts the Mount of Apollo, the Sun. Charm, creativity, an eye for beauty.
The Sun is strong in your palm. Creative work tends to bring you joy, and recognition.
A long little finger strengthens the Mount of Mercury. Persuasive, quick-witted, good with deals.
Mercury favours you with clever words and a sharp sense of humour.
An open thumb enlarges the Mount of Venus. A big heart and a love of life's pleasures.
Venus rules your palm: passion, kindness and a taste for good company.

ARIES.title: Aries
echoes: There's a starter's impatience here too: you'd rather begin than wait for perfect.
A competitive streak shows through. A challenge wakes you right up.

TAURUS.title: Taurus
echoes: There's real staying power here, and a soft spot for comfort and good things.
Once you've decided, you're hard to move, and the people you love count on that.

GEMINI.title: Gemini
echoes: There's a quick, curious streak too: you're rarely without a question or a story.
You adapt fast, and conversation comes easily to you.

CANCER.title: Cancer
echoes: There's a protective streak here: home and your people come first.
You pick up on moods before anyone says a word.

LEO.title: Leo
echoes: There's a generous warmth here, and people notice when you walk into a room.
You give loyalty and praise freely, and you shine when you're appreciated.

VIRGO.title: Virgo
echoes: There's a careful eye here: you notice the details others miss.
You show care by being useful, and you quietly hold things together.

LIBRA.title: Libra
echoes: There's a peacemaker in this hand: you weigh both sides and look for the fair answer.
Harmony matters to you, and you have a gift for putting people at ease.

SCORPIO.title: Scorpio
echoes: There's an intensity here: you see through people, and you don't do things by halves.
Your loyalty runs deep, and so does your memory.

SAGITTARIUS.title: Sagittarius
echoes: There's a restless optimism here: new horizons pull at you.
You say what you think, and your honesty is part of your charm.

CAPRICORN.title: Capricorn
echoes: There's quiet ambition here: you play the long game, and usually win it.
Discipline comes naturally. You climb steadily while others sprint and stall.

AQUARIUS.title: Aquarius
echoes: There's an original streak here: you'd rather be yourself than fit in.
You think about the bigger picture, and the people in it.

PISCES.title: Pisces
echoes: There's a dreamer's softness here, and a deep well of compassion.
You sense what others feel, sometimes before they do.

ui.disclaimer: Palm reading is for entertainment and reflection only.
